items.decision_note: Cannot safely determine whether editable source files became a client-authoritative deliverable or were superseded by the PNG/JPG selection.
Attachment context is needed to route message 32 and determine whether the batch completion claim also applies to the meat illustration.
The typography, layout, wording, and spelling changes cannot be assigned to a specific illustration without visual context.
The dark-background correction cannot be routed to a Requirement without the referenced visual.
The final correction target is unresolved because the source refers only to an unavailable visual.

unresolved_candidate.description: The freelancer promised hand-drawn vector illustrations and source files, but the client later selected PNG and JPG when asked to choose between AI and PSD. It is unclear whether editable source files became an authoritative additional deliverable or were superseded by raster-only delivery.

The three feedback messages likely correspond to the three separate illustrations, but absent attachment context prevents fully certain routing of every revision, especially the generic cartoon-style request in message 32.
The font, two-line arrangement, revised slogan wording, and spelling correction are clear changes, but the text alone does not conclusively identify which illustration received them.
The requested clearing of a dark background around an unspecified word depends on unavailable visual context and cannot yet be routed safely to a particular illustration.
The final correction is referenced only as 'Just this' with missing visual context, so its target behavior cannot be identified safely.
